findings.issue: Optional subprocess inspection can wait past cancellation on inherited output pipes.
findings.disposition: Fixed: owned Unix groups/Windows jobs and bounded pipe draining.

findings.issue: SIGTERM to the installer can leave its subprocess alive without the parent timer.
findings.disposition: Fixed: installer SIGTERM cancels owned subprocess work.

findings.issue: Cancellation during the final installer write can still return success and discard its journal.
findings.disposition: Fixed: final-write/validation cancellation triggers rollback or retained recovery.

findings.issue: Inherited harness dispatch guard bypasses disposable fixture provisioning.
findings.disposition: Fixed: disposable setup no longer trusts inherited dispatch intent.

findings.issue: Completed installation recovery can accept cancellation and discard its journal.
findings.disposition: Fixed: completed recovery preserves journal on cancellation; shared re-review discovery by both architecture profiles.

findings.issue: Unix inherited-pipe tests lack a direct descendant-death and reachability oracle.
findings.disposition: Accepted nonblocking coverage suggestion; owner AL-60 maintainer for Unix descendant-death/reachability fixture follow-up; no current leak demonstrated.
